title: Choose the visual world for Investor Hub
question: The roll assigned the Nutrition Panel. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Nutrition Panel
options.lineage: the printed nutrition-facts panel on every Snackible pack
options.thesis: Every number is set like a pack's nutrition panel: rank carried by heavy rule, weight and case, never by decoration.
options.viewport: Turmeric nav rail; this week's 312/500 contacted as the panel's 'per serving' headline; follow-ups due and a paste-to-check box below.
options.risk: If the rules are set timidly it reads as a plain table with a yellow sidebar.

raised.raise: A short type scale: rank comes from weight, case, reversal and rule weight, not from ever-larger numbers.
The 500-a-week target is drawn as a fixed capacity that visibly fills, and overflow shows past the line.
Full commitment to flat, unmodulated colour fields: no gradients, glass or grain anywhere.
No card chrome: KPIs and tables sit directly on the label, separated only by rules.
Pipeline stages are drawn at one shared scale so their sizes compare honestly.

options.label: Reservation Chart
options.lineage: the Indian Railways reservation chart pasted on the coach door
options.thesis: Every email carries a status code like a berth: CNF contacted, WL staged, CAN do-not-contact, checked against the chart before boarding.
options.viewport: Navy top bar; this week's chart of contacted vs target; the status-code legend leads into today's follow-ups.
options.risk: The most obvious Indian reference for a status list; codes need a legend for new team members.

options.label: Split-flap Concourse
options.thesis: Follow-ups due are departures: rows ranked by time, status flaps cascading as investors move.
options.viewport: Dark board of today's follow-ups by owner, with amber 'overdue' rows and the weekly count flipping beside it.
options.case: Fuses cleanly for the follow-up board and holds on clarity; loses on audience identification and on dense analytics pages.
options.risk: A dark board fatigues over a full working day of tables.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: 1970s pocket airline timetables on a light table
options.thesis: One type size; rank by weight, case and rule on raked glass slides.
options.viewport: A raked rack of slides travelled sideways.
options.case: Raked containers fight dense tables; the team doesn't recognise this world.
options.kept: Rank carried by weight, case and rule rather than size.

options.label: Cassette J-card
options.thesis: Side A / side B, timed so each side fills exactly.
options.viewport: One folded inlay, the week as side A.
options.case: Handwriting hurts data legibility; no tie to fundraising.
options.kept: A hard capacity that must not overflow, made visible.
options.risk: Reads as whimsy on an operations screen.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.case: Organic lobes waste space on tables; nothing in the team's world.
options.kept: Total commitment to flat, unmodulated colour.
options.risk: Playful to the point of distraction.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.thesis: Giant cropped lowercase; chrome deleted so type is the interface.
options.case: Panorama navigation and cropped headlines hide data.
options.kept: No card chrome; type and rules do the separating.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: One plant through its stages at one fixed scale.
options.case: Lovely for stages, but too ornamental for a daily tool.
options.kept: Stages drawn at one shared scale for honest comparison.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS analytics dashboard (Linear / Stripe style), executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Left sidebar, KPI cards across the top, a chart and a follow-ups table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other dashboard by design.
